content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To find a nice place to meet men, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Read online reviews of local sports bars (30 minutes)
Step 2. Research upcoming charity gala events (2 hours)
Step 3. Ask married friends where they met their spouses (1 hour)
Step 4. Buy a new outfit for social outings (3 hours)
Step 5. Look up local co-ed recreational sports leagues (45 minutes)
Step 6. Sign up for a beginner’s kickball season (20 minutes)
Step 7. Check the schedule for weekend hiking groups (15 minutes)
Step 8. Browse "meetup" groups for professional networking (1 hour)
Step 9. Update social media profiles with new photos (2 hours)
Step 10. Purchase a ticket for a tech conference (15 minutes)
Step 11. Ask a coworker for recommendations on quiet lounges (20 minutes)
Step 12. Search for popular dog parks in the city (30 minutes)
Step 13. Map out the driving route to the downtown district (10 minutes)
Step 14. Look for woodworking or DIY workshops (1 hour)
Step 15. Make a reservation at a high-end steakhouse bar (5 minutes)
Step 16. Create a shortlist of top three potential locations (30 minutes)
Step 17. Draft a list of personal interests and hobbies (1 hour)
Step 18. Get a fresh haircut (1 hour)
Step 19. Identify neighborhoods with high foot traffic (2 hours)
Step 20. Visit a local pet supply store to buy treats (30 minutes)
Step 21. Check the calendar for local trivia nights (30 minutes)
Step 22. Register for a volunteer orientation session (1 hour)
Step 23. Iron and prepare your chosen outfit (30 minutes)
Step 24. Withdraw cash for tips and parking (10 minutes)
Step 25. Pay the registration fee for the sports league (5 minutes)
Step 26. Pack a small bag with essentials like mints and a charger (15 minutes)
Step 27. Buy a new bottle of perfume or cologne (45 minutes)
Step 28. Enroll in a weekend furniture-building class (20 minutes)
Step 29. Search for "best happy hour" spots for professionals (1 hour)
Step 30. Rent a formal dress or suit for the gala (2 hours)
Step 31. Set a budget for the evening's drinks and food (15 minutes)
Step 32. Select the specific day of the week to go out (10 minutes)
Step 33. Look for popular bookstores with coffee shops (40 minutes)
Step 34. Read a blog about "how to approach people in public" (1 hour)
Step 35. Find a local animal shelter looking for volunteers (30 minutes)
Step 36. Attend the first session of the woodworking class (3 hours)
Step 37. Ask a sibling for an honest opinion on your style (1 hour)
Step 38. Call a friend to see if they want to join you (15 minutes)
Step 39. Buy a pair of athletic shoes (1 hour)
Step 40. Buy a notebook to jot down ideas (10 minutes)
Step 41. Look up the dress code for the shortlisted places (20 minutes)
Step 42. Check the weather forecast for the outdoor league (5 minutes)
Step 43. Charge your phone to full battery (2 hours)
Step 44. Clean and vacuum your car (1 hour)
Step 45. Take a relaxing shower and get ready (1 hour)
Step 46. Purchase a sturdy water bottle for sports (15 minutes)
Step 47. Brainstorm a list of conversation starters (45 minutes)
Step 48. Put on your shoes and grab your keys (5 minutes)
Step 49. Check your reflection in the mirror (5 minutes)
Step 50. Ask a local barista about the busiest times of day (10 minutes)
Step 51. Look for specialized "hobby" clubs like chess or running (1 hour)
Step 52. Take the dog for a walk to practice being social (45 minutes)
Step 53. Confirm the opening hours of the chosen venue (5 minutes)
Step 54. Download a ride-sharing app (10 minutes)
Step 55. Drive to the chosen location (30 minutes)
Step 56. Look for outdoor gear sales (1 hour)
Step 57. Enter the venue and find a comfortable spot (5 minutes)
Step 58. Visit a trendy coffee shop to observe the crowd (1 hour)
Step 59. Research the best times for networking events (1 hour)
Step 60. Order a drink and look around (10 minutes)
